name: Permanent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires legal and continual residence in Bulgaria for 5 years prior to submitting the application, most commonly built up while holding a long-term/prolonged residence permit (Foreigners Act Article 24d(1)).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 consecutive years of legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate means of subsistence for self and family sufficient not to resort to social assistance, at least the minimum national salary or pension, plus mandatory health insurance (Article 24d(9)).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous legal residence

outcome.duration_length: indefinite, subject to withdrawal grounds under Article 40

sources.title: Bulgaria -- Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, Article 24d: permanent residence after 5 years' continual prior legal residence, financial/insurance conditions, 2-month (extendable to 4-month) processing timeline

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the Citizenship Act's Article 12 standard naturalisation bar, which counts from acquiring PERMANENT (not merely long-term) residence -- see bg_naturalisation.json for the fuller ~10-year total-pipeline explanation (5 years long-term residence to reach permanent residence, then 5 more years of permanent residence to naturalise). Article 25 of the Foreigners Act also references direct/expedited permanent-residence categories for specific groups, but the fetched excerpt cut off before full detail was available -- flagged as a possible gap, not modeled here.
